semiconductor_relevance: High — Shinsho Corporation specializes in precision machining of aluminum components specifically for semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
summary: Shinsho Corporation focuses on the production of high-precision aluminum chambers and parts for semiconductor manufacturing equipment. They emphasize environmentally responsible practices, including resource recycling and significant reductions in CO₂ emissions.
capabilities: Precision machining of aluminum chambers for semiconductor equipment
Manufacturing of aluminum parts for LCD manufacturing equipment
Integrated production system from material procurement to final machining
Resource-circulating business model with horizontal recycling of machining chips

regional_presence.Japan: The company has established a new facility in Tochigi Prefecture dedicated to precision machining.
